replacement:
(def parents
  "Returns the immediate parents of tag through a relationship established
  via derive. h must be a hierarchy obtained from make-hierarchy, if not
  supplied defaults to the global hierarchy"
  (fn
    ([tag] (parents @(get-global-hierarchy) tag))
    ([h tag] (not-empty (get (:parents h) tag)))))
rationale: Expand the complete pinned defn to def/fn, retaining its documentation (#30). Suss types have no supertypes, so the type-inheritance branches of Clojure's and ClojureScript's versions (bases, supers, isAssignableFrom) contribute nothing and are removed (#30).
